groups.description: Item groups (F2, ADR 061): an item's kind names its group, for stockpile filters (F5). When declared, ContentRegistry rejects an item whose kind is not listed (dangling_reference).

kind.description: The item's group: one of `groups` when that list is declared.

satiety.description: F5b (ADR 065): makes the item edible. Eating one unit sets the food need to min(full, satiety); a hungry colonist eats the most filling reachable food first (a berry bush counts as needs.json food restore, and loses ties to an item).
